ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an ideal operational amplifier circuit. The node of the inverting terminal “−” is connected on one hand through a 1 Ω resistor to the input V3, and on the other hand through a 9 Ω resistor to the output terminal Vout, forming negative feedback. The node of the non-inverting terminal “+” is connected through a 1 Ω resistor to the input V1, and through a 4 Ω resistor to the input V2. Reasoning: Let the non-inverting terminal voltage be Vp and the inverting terminal voltage be Vn. The input current of an ideal op-amp is zero, so write KCL at the “+” node: (Vp−V1)/1 + (Vp−V2)/4 = 0, solving gives Vp = (4V1 + V2)/5. Since ideal negative feedback exists, Vn = Vp. Write KCL at the “−” node: (Vn−V3)/1 + (Vn−Vout)/9 = 0, rearranging gives Vout = 10Vn − 9V3. Substituting Vn = Vp = (4V1 + V2)/5 gives Vout = 10(4V1 + V2)/5 − 9V3 = 8V1 + 2V2 − 9V3.

method.method_draft: Because the ideal op-amp draws no current at the + terminal, replace the V1/V2 resistor network by its open-circuit node voltage: the conductance-weighted average is V+ = (V1/1 + V2/4)/(1/1 + 1/4) = (4V1+V2)/5. Negative feedback through the 9 Ω resistor forces V− = V+. The − node is the weighted average of V3 through 1 Ω and Vout through 9 Ω, so V− = (V3/1 + Vout/9)/(1/1 + 1/9) = (9V3+Vout)/10. Equate this to (4V1+V2)/5 and solve for Vout, giving Vout = 8V1 + 2V2 − 9V3.

推理：理想运放输入端不吸收电流，因此同相端节点电压由 V1 和 V2 的电阻网络开路分压决定：V+ = (V1/1 + V2/4)/(1/1 + 1/4) = (4V1 + V2)/5。由于存在负反馈，理想运放在线性工作时满足 V- = V+。反相端节点也不流入运放输入电流，因此它是 V3 经 1Ω 与 Vout 经 9Ω 的加权平均：V- = (V3/1 + Vout/9)/(1/1 + 1/9) = (9V3 + Vout)/10。令两者相等：(9V3 + Vout)/10 = (4V1 + V2)/5。两边乘以 10 得 9V3 + Vout = 8V1 + 2V2，所以 Vout = 8V1 + 2V2 - 9V3。
